nodes.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks, foundation models, and autonomous intelligent systems.
nodes.name: AI and ML

nodes.definition: Breaking-news style clips, crime reporting, political/cultural commentary, and military conflict footage about real-world civic events.
include: local crime reporting with anchor narration
historical political event footage (e.g. Capitol breach radio)
exclude: AI/ML product, model, or agent discussion
sports highlights or streamer drama without political/civic content
space exploration or scientific research content
nodes.name: News and Current Events

nodes.definition: Space exploration, astronautics, astrophysics, orbital mechanics, planetary science, and empirical scientific inquiry.
nodes.name: Space and Science

nodes.definition: Livestreamer highlight and drama clips alongside traditional sports match highlight footage shared as short social clips.
include: livestreaming personality incidents caught on camera
streamer drama/reaction commentary about another creator's stream
nodes.name: Sports and Streaming Culture

nodes.definition: Agentic AI systems and 'AI employee' bots that autonomously execute multi-step real-world tasks for consumers or businesses.
include: autonomous agents running end-to-end business operations
AI bots that log into a user's tools and complete tasks independently
agents that learn a user's workflows and operate unattended
founder pitches for general computer-use agents
tutorials showing an AI agent autonomously assembling a finished document/deck
exclude: coding-specific IDE/agent-harness tutorials aimed at engineers
business/earnings commentary about AI companies without a specific agent product
nodes.name: AI Agents

nodes.definition: Short-form jokes, reaction memes, and informal hot takes about AI models, companies, or personalities shared on social media without substantive technical/business claims.
include: one-line emotional reactions naming a specific AI model/assistant
comedic reaction posts framed as AI-generated entertainment
amazed one-line reactions to AI-generated creative output
snarky one-liners about a model being restricted after controversy
speculative or absurdist fictional scenarios starring a named AI model
exclude: concrete revenue, funding, or benchmark figures
named product launches with a functional description of what the tool does
nodes.name: AI Culture & Memes

nodes.definition: Business, market, funding, revenue, and geopolitical/competitive dynamics of the AI industry and AI-enabled companies.
include: AI chip/rack demand and semiconductor stock commentary
market selloff or spending-payoff doubts about AI infrastructure
open-weight model release described as trade/dumping strategy
head-of-state or CEO meeting to discuss national AI strategy
startup funding rounds, revenue, or valuation figures for AI companies
exclude: shipped product/feature announcements without market or policy framing
nodes.name: AI Industry and Business

nodes.definition: Announcements and demos of shipped AI-powered products, app features, and generative-media outputs, independent of underlying model benchmarks.
include: voice/agent feature launches added to an existing mainstream app
generative video/image demo reels showcasing a creative output
AI-made film or game winning an award or public showcase
AI-branded classroom or consumer hardware demos
industrial 3D reconstruction / real2sim pipeline product announcements
exclude: model architecture, scaling laws, or capability benchmark reporting
coding assistants, agent harnesses, or SDKs for engineers
stock market or national-strategy framing of AI
nodes.name: AI Product Launches & Demos

nodes.definition: Software engineering tooling, agent harnesses, IDE extensions, coding assistants, SDKs, and developer-focused workflows.
exclude: pure theoretical ML papers without tools
nodes.name: Developer Tools

nodes.definition: Lectures, pedagogical explanations, conceptual deep dives, tutorials, and fundamental principles of machine learning.
nodes.name: Education

nodes.definition: Architectures, capability evaluations, multimodal systems, scaling behavior, and releases of frontier foundation models.
nodes.name: Frontier Models

nodes.definition: AI-powered products and model demos that generate or reinterpret creative media (video, avatars, games, film) for end users and creators.
include: AI avatar/digital-twin video generation products for end users
AI video-generation model releases marketed for creating content
no-code builders for multimodal AI companions
frontier models demonstrated by generating game or interactive creative content
AI reinterpretations of existing film/media concepts

IDE- or SDK-level coding-assistant tooling for engineers
space or astronomy content with no AI-generation angle
